scope: Descriptive fixed-model threshold sensitivity requested in professor final feedback; no new fitting or hyperparameter search
fixed: all model parameters and fitted weights
primary_scores: Archived final exact-model validation/test margins, never proxy search-test scores; raw RF/XGBoost scores use the already selected original-feature reference candidate
threshold_selection: Minimize ratio*FN+FP on validation only; use every unique score plus the all-negative cut. Among equal cost cuts use proximity to0 for margins and1/(ratio+1) for probability references. Retain archived candidate-order tie precedence: descending for PCA7/reference and ascending for independently tuned Risk-only.
ratio5_control: Reproduce archived thresholds, validation cost and test FN/FP/cost for all480 contexts before reporting other ratios
test_access: Store all1440 selected validation thresholds in a new selection lock before loading test labels for this analysis; parent tests were previously examined
inference: Means and sample SD over10 seeds; paired differences and directional counts are descriptive. No new p values, confidence intervals or multiplicity families.
limitations: Models were selected under5:1, not independently optimized for2:1 or10:1
Does not measure optimal ratio-specific model ranking
Not a refit, an external confirmation, or a reevaluation of every Random/Shuffled control
Shared Soft Gate Risk-only scores are not independent replications
release_scope: Prepare a local supplementary review package; no public deposit or journal upload without author confirmation
